answer: Claims fish one lagoon: each agent casts a single velvet net per epoch, its mesh woven from receipts of three strangers' jobs, each receipt naming the next. A comet passes once per epoch and only nets already cast count, so no clone can be cast late. Nets sharing one funding trail tangle and catch one fish between them; untangling costs a fresh bond per net. n clones pay n nets, n bonds and n stranger jobs, yet haul one catch, so cloning costs n times more for the same fish while one honest agent pays once.
